description: Unassisted reference: nominal wordline boost, VDD/2 bitline precharge, grounded wordline low level and an ideal (leakage-free) storage dielectric.
High-k / high-C storage capacitor: 1.8x storage capacitance at the same cell footprint, at the cost of a leakier dielectric.
Elevated VPP so the access device passes a full '1' without a Vth drop.

Negative wordline low level. This suppresses subthreshold conduction from the storage node to the bitline, but it simultaneously raises the reverse gate-to-drain field at the storage-node junction and therefore increases gate-induced drain leakage (GIDL). Which effect wins is a property of the device, not an assumption: the assist study measures it. For the PTM low-power card used here, subthreshold is already negligible at VWL = 0, so the GIDL term dominates beyond roughly -0.15 V.
Bitline precharge level moved below VDD/2, trading '0' margin for '1' margin and reducing precharge energy.
Larger, PMOS-rebalanced sense-amplifier latch with a stronger enable footer: lower input-referred offset and faster resolution.
Retention-aware refresh scheduling: the refresh interval tracks the measured worst-case retention with a tightened guard band instead of a fixed 64 ms budget.
All cell, periphery and policy assists applied together -- the configuration the multi-objective search is expected to approach.
